description: Primary income source. SSB does not provide a direct income-source-by-employment-status table equivalent to SCB's HE0110F in PxWebApi v2. Approximate distributions are derived from AKU-based employment status (table 13618) and Norwegian NAV statistics on transfer payments. This is a simplified fallback with 3 broad categories.
fallback_note: No SSB PxWebApi v2 table provides income component shares conditioned jointly on employment status and age group at national level. Fetch service uses approximate distributions.
